design_invariants.label: memory-is-event-shaped
design_invariants.statement: A session receives the surfaces its profile names. Giving every session the same memory is a default, not a contract.

binding.origin_episode: EXP-SEL-1 (v3.0.0 Origin P1): surface selection was two hardcoded lists keyed on mode, so a review session and a routine session received identical memory.
